sources: https://www.blm.gov/visit/scab-creek-recreation-area (read 2026-11-20): 'located in the foothills of the Wind River Mountains at roughly 8,200 feet. The backpacker parking, pack stock staging area, small vehicle campground and large vehicle campground are all sites within the recreation area.'; 'The area has vault toilettes, and potable water, as well as corrals in areas where pack stock are allowed. No rec.gov facility -> reservable false. Fees $0 confirmed (manual). HORSE-RULE flag on the large-vehicle campground; stored pin is on the small-vehicle campground. Phone empty -> 307-367-5300.
flags: CRITERIA - HORSE RULE (drop candidate, reviewer's call): the only campground the BLM offers to 'trailers, large RV's or campers' is the Large Vehicle Campground, and it is shared with pack stock: 'provides 7 campsites for those wishing to camp with packs stock, trailers, large RV's or campers. There are corrals provided in the campground for pack stock.' The recreation area also has a separate pack stock staging area, but the BLM puts stock and RVs in the same 7-site campground. The other campground is for small vehicles ('one for small vehicles, and one for pack stock, trailers, and large RVs'; 12 sites incl. one group site, no stock); no length is posted, so whether a 23-ft motorhome counts as a 'small vehicle' there is unclear.

note: BLM Pinedale Field Office recreation area at about 8,200 ft in the Wind River foothills, reached from Boulder via WY-353, County Road 122 and 5.5 miles of BLM 5423. Two campgrounds: the Large Vehicle Campground (7 sites, the first left inside the area) is for trailers, large RVs and pack stock, with corrals in the campground; the Small Vehicle Campground at the road's end (12 sites incl. one group site) allows no stock. Trailheads to Scab Lake and the Bridger Wilderness. --Claude
